jobs.title: Health Information Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

  

The Department of Corrections (DOC) is focused on public safety through the custody and supervision of those in our care. Corrections employees have the opportunity to positively impact the lives of others through careers in a variety of fields. Using evidence\-based approaches, employees implement lasting change with a positive impact for the people of Wisconsin.


The Division of Management Services is currently recruiting to fill a Health Information Supervisor position. This position will be headquartered at Dodge Correctional Institution in Waupun, WI.


**Position Summary**
--------------------

  

This position provides professional guidance in the planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of the DOC’s health information program, including management of paper Health Care Records (HCRs) and the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). This position will provide high level oversight and assistance to the Bureau of Health Services (BHS) in drafting and overseeing implementation of policies relating to management of patient health records compliant with Wisconsin statutes and federal HIPAA regulations. This position also provides direct supervision of employees and overseeing their release of information work, and in guiding HCR project related work.
  

  

This position also provides professional and technical consultation to other state agencies regarding patient medical records and other BHS records, such as substance use disorder (SUD) treatment records, and conducts audits on HCR access and utilization regarding all Persons in Our Care (PIOC) across DOC’s 36 prisons. This position assists with policy development and overseeing policy implementation and training on all DOC HCR access, collection, retention, release, privacy and destruction. Additionally, this position provides ongoing professional leadership in guiding the DMS initiative to convert outstanding paper HCRs into electronic files for storage and ready access in the EMR and oversees the project coordinator who serves as the lead worker on this initiative.


**Salary Information**
----------------------

  

The starting pay is between $58739 and $96720 per year, plus excellent benefits. Pay will be set in accordance with the Compensation Plan and Wisconsin Administrative Code in effect at the time of hire. The pay schedule/range is 81\-03\. A 12\-month probationary period is required.


In addition to meaningful and rewarding work, we offer a competitive benefits package featuring:


* Substantial leave time including at least 3\.5 weeks of vacation to start, 9 paid holidays, and ample accrued sick time that rolls over each year.
* Insurance: Excellent and affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* An exceptional pension plan including a lifetime retirement payment.
* An optional tax\-advantaged 457 retirement savings plan.
* The *Well Wisconsin Program* helps participants set health and well\-being goals, track progress, stay motivated, and earn incentives.
* Our Employee Assistance Program offers employees and their immediate family a variety of tools, resources, and professional consultation services to support their health, goals, and overall well\-being.
* DOC is a qualifying employer for the *Public Service Loan Forgiveness* program.
* Please click here for a summary of State of Wisconsin employment benefits or click here to explore employment benefits on the website.

To help you understand what your benefit package would be worth, please see the Total Rewards Calculator here.


**Job Details**
---------------

  

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in the United States (i.e., a citizen or national of the U.S., a lawful permanent resident, an alien authorized to work in the U.S. without DOC sponsorship) at the time of application. The Department of Corrections will conduct criminal background checks on applicants prior to selection to determine whether the circumstances of any conviction may be related to the job being filled. Upon hire, all new DOC employees are subject to fingerprinting.


The Department of Corrections may conduct pre\-employment drug screens. Any applicant who is offered employment in a position which requires a pre\-employment drug screen must pass the screen as a contingency to employment.

  

  

**NOTE: This position is eligible to work remotely up to 3 days per week.**


**Qualifications**
------------------

  

**Minimally qualified candidates will have experience:**


* Auditing medical records for compliance with established policies and/or procedures


* Developing and implementing programs policies, procedures, and/or guidelines pertaining to health information


* Leading or supervising staff (assigning/reviewing work, training, etc.)

  

**In addition to the above, well qualified candidates will have experience:**


* Utilizing electronic medical records


* Supervising staff in a healthcare setting


**How To Apply**
----------------

  

To apply, click on “Apply for Job” to start the application process. Follow the steps outlined in the application process and submit your application. Permanent classified employees who are eligible for consideration as a transfer or voluntary demotion must complete the application process in order to be considered.
  

  

Applicants should attach a letter of qualifications and resume detailing their training and experience relating to the qualifications mentioned above. It is not necessary to include references at this time. Your letter of qualifications and resume will be evaluated and is considered the assessment for this position and **should be limited to a maximum of two pages each.**
  

  

Your submission will be evaluated by one or more job experts. The most eligible candidates will be invited to participate in the next step of the selection process. The Department of Corrections has created extra guidance to assist you in developing your resume and letter of qualifications, if interested please click **here****.**
  

  

Questions can be directed to Phia Vang, Human Resources Specialist at Phia.Vang@wisconsin.gov.
  

  

The State of Wisconsin is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer seeking a diverse and talented workforce. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities.
  

  

The State of Wisconsin offers a special program for qualified veterans with a 30% or greater service\-connected disability. If you are a qualified veteran, please visit the Veterans Employment page for application instructions to be considered for the Veterans Non\-Competitive Appointment program.


**Deadline to Apply**
---------------------

  

Online applications and materials must be submitted by 11:59pm on **October 11th, 2026\.**


For general wisc.jobs user information and technical assistance, please see the wisc.jobs Commonly Asked Questions page. Some users report better performance when using the Chrome browser.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**AnewHealth is one of the** **nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full\-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All\-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.**

**Job Details**

  

The Onboarding Specialist will grow ExactCare’s patient base throughout the United States by promoting and educating patients on our medication management solutions through phone\-based medication assessments, registering patients for our services. The Specialist will build relationships with patients through exceptional customer service, strong education of ExactCare solutions, and acting as a go between the patient and their ExactCare pharmacy team.

 **Responsibilities**

  

* Conduct a health and medication review with the patient that includes a thorough review of their list of medications and administration instructions and collecting key health information.
* Responsible for accurate data entry of a patient’s prescription information to ensure the patient will receive the appropriate medications
* Responsible for achieving key performance metrics as set forth by the management team
* Create positive first impression of AnewHealth/ExactCare and the unique services we provide.
* Educate facilities, institutions and patients about ExactCare
* Manage the patient assessment process to grow business and maintain referral relationships
* Maintain accurate records and prepare reports for the consistency of information to be shared with the ExactCare team
* Call on prospective patients daily and schedule them for telephonic reviews and conduct patient follow up calls.
* Participate in daily team huddles, attend training sessions and other ad\-hoc meetings as needed.
* Open lines of communication with management team
* Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

 **Qualifications:** These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 **Education**

  

* Associate’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience to justify an exception.

 **Experience**

  

* 1\+ year of pharmacy customer service experience
* Certified Pharmacy Technician preferred

 **Skills \& Abilities**

* Excellent problem\-solving ability
* Energetic and compassionate phone skills required
* Highly motivational and possesses persuasion skills
* Team oriented and the ability to help others succeed
* Very organized with strong attention to detail
* Excellent with multitasking
* Self\-Starter with little to no supervision needed
* Excellent communication skills; oral, written, facilitation and presentation
* Proficient in MS Office suite
* Passion to help people and enrich their lives

 **Physical/Mental Demands:** This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.

 **Schedule:** This is a full\-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad\-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.


This is a remote position.

*AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full\-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire**.*

**AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self\-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug\-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.**

jobs.title: HRIS/HCM Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
AlphaGov (Casa Moon LLC d/b/a AlphaGov) delivers public\-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.  

  

We engage experienced practitioners as project\-based collaborators. Engagements are remote\-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. We build ready teams for live pursuits — not speculative staffing banks.  

  

This opportunity is contingent upon contract award and final staffing approval. Permission will be requested before including a candidate's name or resume in a proposal.  

  

AlphaGov is seeking an HRIS/HCM Implementation Specialist to support municipal human\-resources information system selection, configuration, data migration, and go\-live readiness for a city/county HR modernization pursuit.  

  

What you'll do:

* Lead or support HRIS/HCM implementation workstreams (requirements, configuration, data conversion, testing, cutover)
* Map HR processes (core HR, benefits, timekeeping, payroll integration) to system capabilities
* Coordinate stakeholders across HR, IT, finance, and vendor teams
* Produce implementation plans, test scripts, training materials, and go\-live checklists
* Contribute HRIS/HCM qualifications and past\-performance narrative to AlphaGov proposals when permissioned

  

**Requirements**  

Required:

* Hands\-on HRIS or HCM implementation experience (Workday, Oracle HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, UKG/Ultimate, Dayforce, or comparable)
* Public\-sector or complex multi\-department HR systems background
* Comfortable as a 1099 / project\-based collaborator with travel as needed for client on\-sites


Nice to have:

* Municipal or county HRIS modernization leadership
* Payroll / timekeeping integration experience
* Change\-management or end\-user training delivery for HR systems

jobs.title: Training Specialist - Florida Institute of Government
jobs.description:
**Department**
--------------

  

John Scott Dailey Florida Institute of Government


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Develop, coordinate, and launch statewide in\-person, virtual, and online training programs that support the educational mission of FSU\-IOG.
* Serve as project lead for assigned training and professional development initiatives, managing programs from initial planning and curriculum development through implementation, evaluation, and completion.
* Develop and refine original training content and curricula independently and in collaboration with subject matter experts (SMEs), instructors, and external consultants.
* Identify, recruit, vet, and coordinate qualified SMEs, instructors, and consultants to support training programs and professional development initiatives.
* Facilitate live instructor\-led training sessions in person and virtually and assist in developing recorded and interactive courses that incorporate lectures, assessments, activities, and supporting resources.
* Manage program logistics and operations, including scheduling, registration, participant communications, training platforms, facilities, instructional materials, attendance, and certificates of completion.
* Serve as a liaison with governmental agencies, educational institutions, professional associations, business and community partners, FSU\-IOG affiliated entities, and other stakeholders to strengthen partnerships and expand training opportunities.
* Pursue and coordinate accreditation or continuing education approval from relevant certifying organizations and professional associations when required.
* Develop program descriptions and marketing copy and collaborate with the FSU\-IOG marketing team to promote training opportunities consistent with organizational branding and communication standards.
* Provide responsive, professional customer service to individuals participating in FSU\-IOG training programs, including assistance with registration, course information, and online learning platforms.
* Maintain and manage program records and reporting, including registrations, attendance, participant information, program revenue, evaluations, and other required documentation.
* Coordinate and monitor program budgets, expenditures, contracts, and agreements with instructors, consultants, and vendors while ensuring compliance with applicable FSU and FSU\-IOG policies and procedures.
* Represent FSU\-IOG at local, regional, and statewide meetings, training programs, conferences, and professional development events.
* Provide on\-site support for FSU\-IOG conferences, training programs, and special events as needed.
* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned in support of FSU\-IOG's programs, mission, and organizational objectives.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* A Bachelor's degree and two years of experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and six years of experience. (Note: a combination of post high school education and experience equal to six years.)
* A valid State of Florida or Georgia Driver’s License or the ability to obtain prior to hire.
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Professional experience in training and development, adult education, professional development, program coordination, project management, or a related field.
* Experience developing, coordinating, and delivering in\-person, virtual, and/or online training programs, including the use of instructional materials, visual aids, and learning technologies.
* Experience working with subject matter experts, instructors, consultants, government professionals, professional associations, or similar stakeholders.
* Strong project management, problem\-solving, organizational, customer service, public speaking, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple programs, projects, deadlines, and priorities with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of event planning principles and experience coordinating, organizing, supporting, and evaluating meetings, training programs, conferences, and related events.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, virtual meeting platforms, and online learning or training technologies.
* Ability and willingness to travel and provide on\-site support for training programs, conferences, meetings, and other departmental events as needed.
**Other Information**
---------------------

  

The John Scott Dailey Florida Institute of Government (FSU\-IOG) is seeking a highly motivated and organized Training Specialist to support the development, coordination, and delivery of high\-quality professional training and educational programs for local and state government professionals, elected and appointed officials, public sector stakeholders, and professional association partners throughout Florida.


This position plays a key role in identifying emerging training needs, developing new statewide programs, coordinating subject matter experts and instructors, and managing training initiatives from concept through completion. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management, communication, customer service, and organizational skills and will be comfortable managing multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.


**Helpful**
-----------

  

The successful candidate will be a proactive professional who can independently manage projects while working collaboratively with colleagues, instructors, government professionals, and external partners. Strong candidates will demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, initiative, and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service.


The position requires an individual who can effectively balance training development, project management, stakeholder engagement, program administration, and event support in a fast\-paced professional environment.


**University Information**
--------------------------

  

One of the nation's elite research universities, Florida State University preserves, expands, and disseminates knowledge in the sciences, technology, arts, humanities, and professions, while embracing a philosophy of learning strongly rooted in the traditions of the liberal arts and critical thinking. Founded in 1851, Florida State University is the oldest continuous site of higher education in Florida. FSU is a community steeped in tradition that fosters research and encourages creativity. At FSU, there’s the excitement of being part of a vibrant academic and professional community, surrounded by people whose ideas are shaping tomorrow’s news!
  

  

Learn more about Florida State University and our campuses.


**FSU Total Rewards**
---------------------

  

FSU offers a robust Total Rewards package. Visit our FSU Total Rewards website to learn more about our Compensation, Benefits, Wellness, Recognition, and Employee Development programs.
  

  

Use our FSU Total Compensation Calculator to calculate Total Compensation options based on potential salary, benefits and retirement contributions, earned leave, and other employment\-related perks.


**How To Apply**
----------------

  

If qualified and interested in a specific job opening as advertised, apply through the FSU Careers site (jobs.fsu.edu). If you are a current FSU employee, apply through myFSU Self Service.
  

  

Applicants are required to complete the online application with all applicable information. Applications must include all work history up to ten years, and education details even if attaching a resume.


**Considerations**
------------------

  

This is an A\&P position.


This position requires successful completion of a criminal history background check.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------

  

FSU is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Epic Implementation Analyst (Contract)
jobs.description:
**PLEASE READ THIS JOB ANNOUCEMENT IN ITS ENTIRETY.** 

**\*\*\* Alameda County Health \- Information Systems does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H\-1B). \*\*\***

**ALAMEDA COUNTY HEALTH**

Alameda County Health (AC Health) is the local government agency that promotes and protects the health and well\-being of all who live, work, learn, and play in Alameda County. We coordinate services and cultivate partnerships with community organizations and providers to help ensure access, organize, and deliver health care and services to people with Medi\-Cal and without insurance, support resilient communities, and improve health for all. We focus on health equity by developing programs and systemic solutions that reduce disparities for the people and communities we serve.

AC Health’s departments and programs focus on services and support that provide care for the whole person.

* The Behavioral Health Department provides mental health and substance use services for people with Medi\-Cal and without insurance and supports people along their path to wellness, recovery, and resilience.
* The Environmental Health Department works to keep our air, water, and food safe; it regulates, protects, and promotes the health of everyone in Alameda County by enforcing environmental health codes to reduce exposure to toxins and diseases.
* The Public Health Department focuses on community and population\-level Health, preventing and addressing root causes of health inequity across a range of communicable and chronic diseases.
* AC Health also provides services through Housing and Homelessness Services, Emergency Medical Services Agency, HealthPAC, and Healthy Schools and Communities.

**THE POSITION**

Under general direction, to analyze department business system needs, and produce, maintain and update software systems to meet those needs. Epic Implementation Analysts are responsible for gathering requirements, defining problems and recommending solutions, writing program and database design specifications, modifying existing systems and providing production support for users and their systems. Analysts may also prepare instructional material for department staff, act as project manager on projects; and performs related duties as required.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATES**

This position performs and/or participates in a variety of moderate to complex research, studies, data analysis, metrics reporting, facilitation and training and assessment related to department performance and strategic planning; design, develop, appraise, and conduct orientation for existing and prospective new programs and service offerings (internal and contracted) and execute various other administrative assignments of varying complexity as assigned.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

The following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Everyone in the classification does not necessarily perform all duties listed.

1\. Performs business systems analysis appropriate to the department's specific needs.

2\. Consults with department representatives to discuss and define business application programming solutions. Defines the scope of system problems and the goals and needs of automated systems; determines methodology to solve application problems.

3\. Prepares feasibility studies to improve a departments’ functions and/or procedures; identifies potential solutions and reports on the advisability of each, including feasibility, equipment requirements, personnel requirements, cost/ benefit effectiveness, time requirements, and makes a recommendation on which solution should be used.

4\. Designs logical structure of application programs and develops program specifications.

5\. Develops programs and applications for mini, networked and non\-networked personal computer using microcomputer, database, or a web Internet languages.

6\. Analyzes and redesigns existing systems (including redesigning data flow, file structure, program processes and report layouts) to address changes in systems requirements and equipment configurations.

7\. Monitors and maintains production systems to assure success.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

Education:

The equivalent to graduation from an accredited four\-year college or university (120 semester units or 180 quarter units) with a major in MIS, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent.

AND

Experience:

The equivalent of two years of full\-time experience in planning, developing and administering Epic systems and other related clinical/ healthcare systems and applications.

AND

Certification:

Current, active certification in one of the following Epic modules:

* Willow Inpatient Pharmacy
* EpicCare Ambulatory EHR incl. Behavioral Health
* Patient Experience/ MyChart
* Cadence/ Prelude Registration
* Grand Central

**HOW TO APPLY**

* Please email the **Resume** and the **Epic Certificate Status document** to: ACH\_IS\_HR@acgov.org
* *To learn more about Alameda County Health visit us here: Health.AlamedaCountyCA.gov*

Pay: $116,168\.00 \- $155,667\.20 per year

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Epic implementation: 2 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* Epic Certification \- Willow Inpatient Pharmacy (Preferred)
* Epic Certification \- EpicCare Ambulatory (Preferred)
* Epic Certification \- Patient Experience/ MyChart (Preferred)
* Epic Certification \- Cadence/ Prelude Registration (Preferred)
* Epic Certification \- Grand Central (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Oakland, CA 94606 (Required)

jobs.title: EHR Analyst, Senior
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  

**Department:** Ambulatory Application  

**Location:** Riedman \- Remote  

**Hours Per Week:** 40  

**Schedule:** Full\-Time, Day\-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am \- 4:00 pm)

 **POSITION SUMMARY:**  

The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced\-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support to end\-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day\-to\-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after\-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.


System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross\-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.


Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams \- including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors \- to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.


Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.


Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end\-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.


Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross\-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  

* Minimum two (2\) to five (5\) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

  

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  

* Current Epic Certification.

jobs.title: Implementation / Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation / Integration Specialist**


Heritage Fencing


Full\-Time \| Portfolio Company Locations / Remote


Travel: Frequent, approximately 75%

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* $75,000–$90,000 base salary
* Bonus opportunity
* Full\-time role with flexibility required to meet the needs of the business
* Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across a growing platform
* High\-impact role supporting integrations, systems, reporting, and operational


improvement

**Location / Work Setup**


As integrations ramp up, this role will be primarily onsite at portfolio company locations and then remote / at\-home as workstreams stabilize. Frequent travel is required, approximately 75%, to build relationships with team members across the platform and support onsite integration work.

**Job Summary**


Heritage Fencing is hiring an Implementation / Integration Specialist to support operational integration initiatives across a growing platform of fencing companies. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is highly reliable, responsive, organized, and willing to help wherever needed. The Implementation / Integration Specialist will work closely with platform leadership, external vendors, and operating company teams to help improve consistency, visibility, communication, and execution across the platform.


The role will involve frequent travel to portfolio company locations to observe workflows, document processes, identify gaps, support system implementations, and help teams adopt new tools and processes. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who can build strong relationships, operate independently, communicate clearly, and keep multiple projects moving in a fast\-paced environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assist with the planning, coordination, and execution of operational integration initiatives across portfolio companies
* Support ERP, field service management, reporting, workflow, CRM, and process implementation initiatives
* Travel onsite to operating companies to observe workflows, document processes, identify gaps, and assist with implementation efforts
* Work alongside office managers, project managers, service teams, and leadership teams to support operational improvements
* Help develop and maintain standardized workflows, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and reporting structures
* Coordinate communication, training, timelines, follow\-up, and action items related to integration initiatives
* Support data gathering, reporting visibility, CRM / HubSpot organization, and operational tracking efforts
* Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement
* Assist with onboarding newly acquired operating companies into platform systems and processes
* Support platform initiatives related to business development, leadership development, and operational excellence
* Collaborate with platform leadership and external vendors to help ensure successful implementation of strategic initiatives
* Help maintain accountability, organization, and momentum across multiple ongoing projects and integrations

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5\+ years of experience in operations, integration, project coordination, process improvement, systems implementation, consulting, construction operations, field service operations, or a related role
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, stakeholders, and follow\-up items
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build trust and credibility with employees at all levels of an organization
* High level of reliability, responsiveness, professionalism, and discretion
* Comfort working onsite with local teams and remotely with platform leadership
* Strong attention to detail and ability to document workflows, processes, action items, and implementation steps
* Ability to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and process improvement opportunities
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, project tracking tools, CRM systems, or related business software
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently, approximately 75%

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP, field service management, CRM, reporting, or dashboard tools
* Experience with HubSpot, ServiceTitan, BuildOps, Sage, QuickBooks, or similar systems
* Experience in fencing, construction, field service, industrial services, or multi\-site operations
